name: Arma
source:
Arma wants to be the best firefighter in the world! Unfortunately for her, so far this has only meant that she's hypervigilant about any teeny tiny bit of smoke that she detects, routinely triggering obnoxious and adrenaline-pumping false alarms. All of this constant anxiety has also had the effect of wearing her down over time, such that her batteries are almost completely drained. What she desperately needs is someone to give her a bit of a break, and to show her that she doesn't need to be keyed all the way up to 11 in order to do her job.
Likes: Urgency, Piercing Noises, Latex
Dislikes: The Middle Path

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
